title: Input Head Position After One Step
statement: Let $M$ be a binary-input machine, let $w$ be an input word, and let $c$ be a configuration on $w$. For $p\le |w|+1$, the indicator that the input-head position after one step is $p$ equals the following Boolean condition: if $c$ is halted, the current position is $p$; otherwise, inspect the transition's input-head move. A right move satisfies the condition when either $p=0$ or the current position is $p-1$ with $p\ge1$; a stationary move satisfies it when the current position is $p$; and a left move satisfies it when either $p=|w|+1$ or the current position is $p+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Input word is a list of bits
Configuration is for the machine on that input
